content.text:
Smoke Alarms must cover the living room, bedroms and technical rooms.
Minimum one per floor. Minimum alarm of 60 dB in living rooms
and bedrooms when doors are closed.

All smoke and heat alarms to be interlinked and mains powered.

content.title: SCOTLAND:
content.text: New Rules apply to all homes from 1st February 2022. All rooms that are used often and every hallway or landing should have an interconnected smoke alarm.

content.title: ENGLAND:
content.text: Rules apply to all rented homes from 1st October 2022. At least 1 smoke alarm should be placed on each floor. Mains powered in new build. Interconnect recommended.

links.link_name: Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Alarm (Amendment) Regulations 2022:

content.title: WALES:
content.text: Rules apply to all rented homes from 1st December 2022. 1 smoke alarm per floor which must be interlinked to other smoke alarms in the home.

content.title: NORTHERN IRELAND:
content.text: One Smoke alarm, hardwired permanently, installed in the room most frequently used for general daytime living purposes, in every circulation space on each storey, such as hallways and landings. Heat alarm installed in kitchen. Interconnection required.

links.link_name: Smoke Alarms in Northern Ireland Homes

content.text: At least one alarm per property and per level, mains powered and interconnected if more than one.

The obligation to install smoke alarms in residential houses in Lithuania
has been in effect since 2017 December 27th.

It is mandatory to install a smoke alarm in every household from 1st
January 2020.

At least one smoke alarm in every flat, if there is a two floor flat at least one smoke alarm in every floor, the same rule for house

Mains / battery powered alarms conforming to EN 14604 required for every
60 m² of each floor of a residence.
Intrconnection recommended for larger properties.

Required since 2011 - one alarm on each floor, inside or outside, every bedroom, directly above each stairs.
Interconnect recommended if multiple alarms are on property.
Smoke Alarms must be installed in circulation areas, living and sleeping spaces and a heat alarm in the kitchen. Interconnection required.
